To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Q-Tales platform, as a case study, is a gamification framework that supports a new disruptive paradigm for the creation of interactive e-books.
the gamification of the Q-Tale ecosystem can be a valuable tool to increase the engagement with the ecosystem and promote the use of its tools.

(i) gamification is a useful approach for motivating professionals to participate in the creation of high quality interactive e-Books for children, (ii) the Q-Tales ecosystem can be used by creative professionals to co-create interactive e-books, (iii) gamification can be applied at different architectural levels, in a distributed system, to support the overall ecosystem.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the gamification of the authoring process of interactive e-books, which is the first step towards the creation of the interactive e-book, as a product of a community.
the gamification of the authoring of children e-books and the creation of a gamified environment, which will motivate the community of creative individuals to participate in the process.
the development of an ecosystem that supports the community of creative people, professionals and parents, co-create high quality interactive children e-books.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Q-Tales ecosystem is a promising initiative, which can be a valuable asset to the children’s digital literature market, as a result of the innovative approach and the gamification strategy.
Q-Tales is the first ecosystem of its kind that aims to gamify the entire process of authoring children e-books and provide a platform to support this process.
the gamification of Q-Tales ecosystem is an effective and efficient way of engaging professionals, experts and children, to participate in creating new interactive e-books.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Q-Tales ecosystem provides a novel approach for the creation of interactive e-books, by supporting the community of creative experts, parents, children, and other stakeholders to co-create new children literature.

we designed a gamified ecosystem that supports the creation of interactive e-books and provides the means to motivate professionals, experts and children participate in the process, in a fun and engaging manner, while at the same time, it provides the necessary feedback to the authors in order to improve the quality of the e-books.

gamification is an effective approach for engaging the creative professionals and experts, as they are motivated to participate in the process of creating high-quality children e-books, while the parents are motivated to adopt the ecosystem.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the gamification of electronic systems is a promising approach to motivate professionals and parents to participate in the creation of interactive e-books and promote their use.

gamification can be used as a tool to motivate and engage users, in a distributed ecosystem, to co-create high quality interactive children ebooks, by leveraging the power of the crowdsourcing and gamification paradigms.
gamification of electronic systems, such as the Q-Tales ecosystem, is a viable solution to drive engagement and promote the use of the system.
